High-visual showcase websites for designers, photographers, developers and agencies.

Good to Know

## Frequently asked questions

**What should a portfolio website include?**

A strong one includes a short introduction, selected projects with case studies, an about section, skills or services, and a clear contact path. Developers often add experience and a CV; photographers add full-screen galleries.

**Do you have examples of portfolio websites you built?**

Yes. karim.deveraxtech.com is a site we designed and built for full-stack developer Karim Ahmed, with featured projects, skills, experience, teaching and contact sections.

**Will my site show up when people search my name?**

We set up your name as the main entity with Person structured data, a descriptive title and meta description, and fast pages, which helps Google and AI assistants connect your name to your site.
